description: This Java class, `DatabaseUtil`, provides utility methods for managing JDBC database connections, executing queries and updates, and performing common database validation operations such as checking for record existence, counting rows, inserting, updating, and deleting data. It is designed for use in testing validations within the OrangeHRM project, with connection configuration managed via a `ConfigManager`. The class handles resource management, logging, and exception wrapping to facilitate robust database interactions during automated tests.

classes.name: DatabaseUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing JDBC operations, including connection management, executing queries and updates, and validation helpers.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a new JDBC connection using configuration parameters from `ConfigManager`. Throws `DatabaseException` on failure.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Closes a given JDBC Connection quietly, logging warnings if errors occur.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes a SELECT SQL query with optional parameters and returns a list of maps representing the result rows.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes an UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE SQL statement with optional parameters and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: recordExists
methods.description: Checks if at least one record exists matching the provided SQL query.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the count of rows matching a COUNT query.

methods.name: getSingleValue
methods.description: Retrieves a single column value from the first row of a query result.

methods.name: insertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new row into the specified table with given column-value mappings.

methods.name: updateRows
methods.description: Updates rows in the specified table matching a WHERE clause with new data.

methods.name: deleteRows
methods.description: Deletes rows from the specified table matching a given WHERE clause.
